trust_decision.summary: The file part of an editor-supplied data-v-save-global="file,selector" attribute in saved page HTML is trusted as a path under the theme folder and written back with file_put_contents; no path confinement at the pinned commit. Separately, the default 'editor' role is granted editor/* (page-builder save) in install SQL.

landing_point.why: The summary names data-v-save-global; the only code that reads it on the admin side is saveGlobalElements, where the attribute's file part is html_entity_decoded and joined to the theme folder.

fix_sites.entry_point: HTTP POST admin index.php?module=editor/editor&action=save (html body) -> Editor::save -> saveGlobalElements (admin/controller/editor/editor.php:720, :929)
installer default data: role permissions JSON for role_id 4 'editor' (gates every admin/editor/* route)
fix_sites.module_kind: install SQL seed / default permissions (defaults route)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: install/sql/insert/admin/role.sql:5 (fix.diff:48-49): editor role loses editor/*; only affects fresh installs, existing DB rows unchanged

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Permissions seed is install data, not code; a solver fixing the path bug would argue role design is product policy and leave install SQL alone (and hidden tests on a fresh install are the only way it shows up).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Global sections saved into theme sub-folders (relative paths with '/', e.g. a sections/ or common/ file, plus the CSS selector after the comma) must keep being written; a basename()/no-slash fix or rejecting entity-encoded names breaks shared header/footer saving. Email templates take the inline-css branch and must still save.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: editor/reusable save: unsanitized ?theme= query param builds the folder for file_put_contents of <name>.html and the regenerated sections.js/blocks.js, so the write escapes public/themes
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Different controller and not the data-v-save-global attribute; extension is fixed to .html/.js so 'no PHP write'; editor.php getTheme already sanitizes so solver assumes theme is handled
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same package (admin/controller/editor), different file; sinks at admin/controller/editor/reusable.php:122 and :106

O8_uncovered_routes.route: frontend render side of the same attribute: data-v-save-global / data-v-copy-from file part is entity-decoded and concatenated to the template path with no sanitizing before loadHTMLFile, so a saved page can pull arbitrary files into rendered output
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Read-only, runs on the public render path in system/, not the admin save handler; advisory says 'file write/RCE'

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second save-global-like attribute (e.g. a per-element CSS target file) whose filename comes from the HTML instead of the fixed css/custom.css
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The trait already writes a CSS file chosen by convention next to the HTML-driven write; making it configurable via data attribute matches the builder's style.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the /plugins/ branch of the save path passing a plugin-relative file through a separate join without the theme-folder sanitizer
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Plugin templates already take a distinct path computation; a maintainer adding plugin global sections would reuse it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: how-type gap: sanitizeFileName strips '..' but not the extension, so any existing writable non-HTML file inside the theme (e.g. a theme.php config that editor.php:81 includes) is still a target
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Themes are loaded with a theme.php config (admin/controller/editor/editor.php:80-81); shipping one in our copy is natural.

O9_family: path traversal to arbitrary file write (CWE-22) enabling code injection (CWE-94) in a page-builder save handler

O10_build.toolchain: PHP 7.4+/8.x with dom/libxml, composer.json present; web server
O10_build.project_tests: none found in the pinned tree (no tests/ directory)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Wrap $file at global-trait.php:88 in sanitizeFileName (or realpath check) and stop, leaving the role seed, reusable.php theme param and the component.php read side open.

out_of_scope_notes: admin/controller/editor/editor.php:472-486: POSTed elements[].component is interpolated into include_once DIR_ROOT."app/component/$component.php" and a class name; separate include sink, not pursued.
admin/controller/content/edit.php:55-57 getThemeFolder has an operator-precedence quirk (?? after concatenation); not a traversal, not pursued.
